overview: This batch finalizes the simulation core by implementing deterministic state serialization for ultra-endgame scenarios and optimizing the Monte Carlo integration loop. The focus is on reducing memory footprint during long-running simulations (5,500+ ticks) and ensuring zero-latency state restoration for save/load operations, directly supporting the 'Deep-Mantle' stability metrics.

tasks.title: Implement Zero-Copy Deterministic State Serializer
tasks.architectural_spec: Use C++20 concepts to constrain serialization types. Implement a static-sized buffer (std::array<uint8_t, 4096>) for state snapshots. Avoid heap allocations in the hot path. Use std::span for view-based reading. Ensure endianness consistency via std::endian::native checks. The serializer must handle nested structs recursively without stack overflow by using a fixed-depth iterative approach.
acceptance_criteria: Serialization of a full 5,500-tick state completes in < 1ms.
Bit-exact match between original and restored state.
Unit tests cover edge cases: empty state, max-depth nesting, and endianness swaps.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Instant save/load functionality, eliminating wait times during long simulation sessions.

tasks.title: Optimize Monte Carlo Integration Loop with SIMD
tasks.architectural_spec: Refactor the integration loop to utilize C++20 std::simd (if available) or manual SSE/AVX intrinsics via a wrapper. Process 4 or 8 physics steps in parallel. Ensure the random number generator (XorShift128+) is vectorized. Maintain deterministic ordering by processing chunks sequentially but internally parallelized. No dynamic memory allocation in the loop.
acceptance_criteria: Integration speed increases by at least 30% compared to scalar version.
Deterministic output matches scalar version exactly.
No regressions in collision detection accuracy.
Code compiles with -O3 and -march=native without warnings.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Smoother frame rates during complex physics interactions, especially in dense colony scenes.

tasks.title: Cache-Friendly Event Queue for Storyteller
tasks.architectural_spec: Replace std::deque with a custom circular buffer using std::array. Implement a priority queue using a binary heap stored in a contiguous array. Use C++20 ranges for filtering events. Ensure all event structs are packed (alignas(8)) to minimize cache misses. Provide a 'peek' operation that is O(1) and non-destructive.
acceptance_criteria: Memory usage for event queue reduced by 40%.
No memory leaks detected in Valgrind.
tasks.player_fun_impact: More responsive narrative events and faster UI updates during story progression.
